items.title: Von Freeman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Were there any women besides Melba in those big bands and stuff?

ctx.x: Busting up the high notes and carrying on. She used to come down to the Trocadero, where I was.
Were there any women besides Melba in those big bands and stuff?
They always had the Sweethearts of Rhythm. That was a whole lady band, about 17 pieces.
